impact: Reset gates only the initial manifest unlink; if authority transfers afterward, the stale writer keeps deleting generations/pins while the successor rebuilds in the same version dir — it can delete the successor's newly committed generation after its manifest went live, leaving a corrupt live store. One assertion before a recursive removal cannot close this (recursive reset is many mutations). Fix: explicit non-following traversal, assertHeld() immediately before EVERY individual reset mutation, stop at first failure; interleaving test transfers authority after the unlink, lets the successor rebuild, resumes the stale reset, proves zero further mutations.
